description: This file is a C header file defining function declarations related to preloading index data structures for a version control system, potentially Git. It declares functions for preloading an index and reading a repository index preloaded, along with forward declarations of relevant structs.

methods.name: preload_index
methods.description: Preloads the index data structure with optional refresh flags, given the index state and pathspec.

methods.name: repo_read_index_preload
methods.description: Reads the repository's index into memory with preloading, given the repository, pathspec, and refresh flags.
